settings.heading: How It Works
settings.body: Where past valuation certificates are available, we use that documentation to estimate current retail values — otherwise, we work from descriptions, photos, receipts and our consultants' own notes to reach an accurate figure. Appointments can be arranged by phone, in our showroom, or at your home or workplace, Monday to Friday with extended hours available. Sending items to us instead? We use a secure, fully trackable and fully insured delivery service.

settings.heading: Valuation Certificates & Timeframes
settings.body: We complete appraisals within strict time frames, and if your insurer needs more time to consider other parts of your claim, we're happy to chase a progress update on your behalf. For items with a retail value over $1,000, we provide an independent valuation from a registered NCJV valuer for re-insurance purposes.

settings.hero_tagline: Accurate valuations for insurance, claims and peace of mind
settings.hero_intro: Whether you need a valuation for an insurance claim or simply want your collection accurately documented for re-insurance, our consultants assess each piece carefully to establish a fair, current retail value.
